identity.name: Protocol 200 v2
identity.targetDate: ~November–December 2026 (~33–43 weeks at 0.5–0.65 kg/week, adjusted for hypothyroidism)

targets.Walking daily (scoreboard): 30 min at 4–5 kmph OR 45 min at 3–4 kmph

phases.focus: Machine-only workouts, learn every machine, build habit, fix gut, stop binge cycle
Add goblet squats, DB rows, DB press. Buy dumbbells. Progressive overload begins.
Full hybrid program, increase HIIT frequency, tighten carbs on rest days
Final push to 70 kg, refeed days every 10 days

rules.title: Thyroxine first, food later.
rules.description: Take 50 mcg Levothyroxine at 6:00 AM with plain water only. Wait 30 min before lemon water or any food. No curd/milk/paneer at breakfast (wait 4 hours after pill). No coffee for 30 min after pill.

rules.title: No Swiggy/Zomato food orders after 7:30 PM.
rules.description: Uninstall the apps. Re-install only for weekly grocery orders.

rules.title: No maida
rules.description: (refined flour) in any form — no white bread, naan, paratha made with maida, Domino's, packaged biscuits.

rules.title: No deep-fried food
rules.description: — no pakoras, samosas, fried aloo, fried parottas.

rules.title: No sugar-loaded sweets
rules.description: — Biscoff, Kunafa, Rasmalai, Ghewar, Gulab Jamun = permanently banned.

rules.title: Oil discipline:
rules.description: Cook uses max 1 tsp (5ml) oil per dish. Zero butter, cream, ghee.

rules.title: Walking pad = study time.
rules.description: Minimum **30 min/day at 4–5 kmph** (or **45 min at 3–4 kmph**) while reviewing notes or listening to exam audio.

rules.title: Sleep by 11:30 PM, wake by 6:00 AM.
rules.description: Non-negotiable for cortisol control, recovery, and thyroxine timing.

rules.title: Weekly weigh-in:
rules.description: Every Monday morning, fasted, after bathroom. Log in Metrics.md.

rules.title: No skipping protein.
rules.description: Every meal must have a protein source (chicken, eggs, paneer, dal, curd).

rules.title: Exam prep is sacred.
rules.description: Workouts energize, never exhaust. If gym would cost study time, do bodyweight + walking pad at home.
